slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the demand at each demand point j, must the full demand b_j be satisfied exactly (i.e., total received equals b_j), or is it acceptable to receive less than b_j (demand is a minimum that should be met if possible)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must receive exactly b_j or may receive less, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, where total cost equals the sum of all unit transportation costs (production-to-station and station-to-demand) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about minimizing total cost including both transportation and fixed station costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the only unresolved item was integrality, which is not a listed hidden slot and was explicitly noted as an assumption.

summary: The agent recovered both P0 hidden slots by directly asking about exact demand satisfaction and the total-cost minimization objective, then stopped appropriately after resolving the core modeling facts.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
